law.source: measured: scripts/keytrack_study.py (reports/tube_synth/keytrack/{law_before,track_0.5,track_1,pressure_0,pressure_7.5,pressure_15}.json): each row's response fitted with a 2-pole low-pass (f0, Q) down to -30 dB, against the row's V4 grid volts; RESONANCE 0. law_before predates the ADSR and the LFO.

cutoff_g4.source: measured: reports/tube_synth/keytrack/law_before.json (CUTOFF against V4's grid, KEY TRACK 0; rows without g4 placed through the rows' g4 -> Hz)

key_track_g4_per_semitone.source: measured: reports/tube_synth/keytrack/track_{1,0.5}.json (V4's grid against the key, notes 48-84, median over CUTOFF)

pressure_g4_per_v.source: measured: reports/tube_synth/keytrack/pressure_{0,7.5,15}.json (V4's grid against the strip's volts, PRESSURE 1, median over CUTOFF)

vca.source: measured: scripts/velocity_study.py (reports/tube_synth/proxy/velocity_adsr.json: a key held at each key-down voltage, the panel's defaults, pitch -15 V; the envelope node's volts against the out's rms re full scale)

glide.source: measured: scripts/glide_study.py (reports/tube_synth/glide.json: the -20 -> -15 V step's time to within 10 cents, as a one-pole tau = t / ln(step / 10 cents)); before VIBRATO's RPSUM (GLIDE 0 is ~4.7 ms since, its 50 ms smoothing limits it anyway); GLIDE 1's 2 s window was short

lfo.source: measured: scripts/lfo_study.py (reports/tube_synth/lfo.json: LOW range at 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.7 / 1, VIBRATO and WOBBLE at 1) and scripts/ring_study.py (reports/tube_synth/ring/built.json: both ranges); RATE 0 LOW is the design's 0.08 Hz (tube_synth.yaml); VIBRATO and WOBBLE linear in their pots (the design's)

ring.source: measured: scripts/ring_study.py (reports/tube_synth/ring/built.json: RING 1, OSC 0, three pitches by four carriers; means). Its band limits aren't measured

oscillator.source: measured: scripts/vco_study.py (reports/tube_synth/vco/lc.json, production, -25 V: the tank (WAVE 0's) and the out at WAVE 0.5, 12 harmonics re the fundamental, on vco_lc.yaml, the synth's oscillator on its own); WAVE 1 provisional: a square (the design: tank to square). Sine phases (not measured: single cycles owed)

key_level.source: measured: scripts/proxy_sweep.py (reports/tube_synth/proxy/key_level.json: a key held at velocity 127, the panel's defaults, each at the app's tuning and AUTO's range; rms re full scale; the key's frequency against equal temperament, cents: where the device's tuning puts it)

saw.source: measured: HYBRID_PHYSICS_PLAN.md H4 (the saw alone -9.3 dBV, the LC alone -7.3 dBV at full levels); its shape provisional: a sawtooth (single cycles owed)

envelope.source: provisional: the circuit file's design comments (tube_synth.yaml: ATTACK ~5 ms to ~0.7 s, DECAY ~18 ms to ~2 s, RELEASE ~10 ms to ~2 s, time constants, audio taper; SUSTAIN from the -105 V rail to ~-2 V, linear; the bus at rest -110 V); a sweep per pot is owed

resonance.source: provisional: the standalone tube filter (TUBE_SYNTH_PLAN.md S2: ~+8 dB at the cutoff at low CUTOFF, +2 dB at 0.75, +0.7 dB at 1; self-oscillation from ~0.8 at low CUTOFF); not measured on tube_synth: a sweep is owed

env_amount.source: provisional: TUBE_SYNTH_PLAN.md S5 (before the ADSR: at CUTOFF 0.15, ENV AMOUNT 1 held the cutoff at ~4.7 kHz, near the CUTOFF pot's top: about the pot's 27 V of V4's grid at full envelope); a sweep is owed
